title: All Core Devs - Testing (ACDT) #101, October 19, 2026
agendaMarkdown:
### Discussions

#### Glamsterdam

- Glamsterdam network updates: Sepolia (forked Oct 6), devnet-8 (benchmarking), devnet-12, mainnet shadow forks.
  - Led by Protocol Devops
- Revisit [ethereum/consensus-specs#5736](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5736) (separate builder and validator deposits at the Gloas fork): not for Hoodi; prototype, merge after Hoodi, test on a short-lived devnet, don't delay mainnet ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6223076039)).
  - Led by @jtraglia
- Hoodi: fork Mon Oct 26, 17:42:48 UTC (epoch 132352), gas limit 200M at the fork. Release status vs the [EF blog post](https://blog.ethereum.org/en/2026/10/16/glamsterdam-hoodi-announcement): Geth, Erigon, Reth releases with Hoodi support still pending.
  - Led by @danceratopz
- BAL retention: ELs keep BALs available via `engine_getPayloadBodiesBy*V2` for 14,299 epochs ([ethereum/EIPs#12347](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12347)). Per-EL status and a finality clause for CLs that blind unfinalized payloads ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6261344696)).
  - Led by @nerolation

#### Hegota

- Heads up: suggested scoping process change: unmerged EIPs stay off call agendas; PFI'd EIPs without client support default to DFI ([ethereum/pm#2275](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/2275)). Please review before ACDE #248.
  - Led by @barnabasbusa
- Hegota devnets: `heze-devnet-1` (FOCIL) and `bogota-devnet-1` (frames) are live.
  - `heze-devnet-2` alignment ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6193239941)): CL slot duration (12s?), EL blob schedule (12/18 or 14/21?), IL deadline ([ethereum/consensus-specs#5727](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5727) in?).
  - Led by @danceratopz
- Hegota devnet plan: `hegota-devnet-0` before Mumbai? Lock `hegota-devnet-1` EL scope: EIP-8298, EIP-8131, EIP-8279, EIP-8253, EIP-4758 ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6265056113)).
  - Led by @spencer-tb
- Name for I*, the CL upgrade after Heze ([Magicians thread](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/i-star-name-for-consensus-layer-upgrade-after-heze/26717)).
  - Led by @barnabasbusa

### EL breakout

- discv5 defaults: confirm discv5 is on by default in each EL's Hoodi release.
- BPO test forks based on Amsterdam: `BPO2ToBPO3` -> `AmsterdamToBPOIncrease`, `BPO3ToBPO4` -> `BPOIncreaseToBPODecrease` ([ethereum/execution-specs#3597](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3597)). No changes needed for Erigon, ethrex, Nethermind, Reth; PRs for Besu ([besu-eth/besu#11646](https://github.com/besu-eth/besu/pull/11646)), Geth ([ethereum/go-ethereum#35975](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/35975)), Nimbus-EL ([status-im/nimbus-eth1#5012](https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth1/pull/5012)).
  - Led by @danceratopz
- Heads up: EELS hive simulators as prebuilt images ([ethereum/execution-specs#3572](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3572), [ethereum/hive#1609](https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/1609)): simulator builds drop from 100+ s to seconds; select releases with `--sim.buildarg tag=<tag>`. Client CI PRs to review for Erigon, ethrex, Nethermind, Reth.
  - Led by @spencer-tb

### CL breakout

- [ethereum/beacon-APIs#627](https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/627) (`produceBlockV4WithBid`): ship as Experimental? ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6217620985))
  - Led by @eth2353
- [ethereum/consensus-specs#5727](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5727) on `heze-devnet-2` ([comment](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2271#issuecomment-6257399197))
  - Led by @rolfyone
